notes: v4.32.0: Focus is a ring under the clock. Tap the time to start, pause, or resume. SET opens length, task, reset, and full screen. Music is a listening rail under the orbit: real title or station name, a spectrum only when the audio can be read, otherwise a motion ring that is not the audio. One tap plays, pauses, and skips. The full player opens without restarting the song.
